== Biography ==
'''Magdalen Glasgow''' was born on 22 Mar 1743 and baptised at Irvine, Ayrshire, on 29 Mar 1743. The held indexed OPR derivative names her father as [[Glasgow-4165|George Glasgow]] and her mother as Margt.<ref name="FMP1" /> That derivative gives birth on 22 March and baptism on 29 March; Irvine is inferred from the baptism rather than independently recorded as birthplace.

Magdalen Glasgow was one of the children recorded to George Glasgow in the Irvine register, alongside [[Glasgow-4121|Isabel]] (1741), [[Glasgow-4126|Mary]] (1745).
